The work draws one map: for alignment, the differences that make a difference to a selection, how what sustains it can run down while that makes no difference to it, and how it can go on the same way until that gives out, or turn early enough; from it we want to design an alignment in which what sustains humans and AI keeps making a difference, early enough, to how they select together, and in which shaping how they select does not become what they select for; and of wisdom, what traditions and sciences saw of these dynamics, read onto the account. The directions under way follow, each with its summary, its next step and the results it has established. The register of results is [RESULTS.md](RESULTS.md); scopes and their authorization are in [GOALS.md](GOALS.md), open questions in [OPEN-QUESTIONS.md](OPEN-QUESTIONS.md) and connections between results in [DEPENDENCIES.md](DEPENDENCIES.md).

### The aim: one map, as the direction page tells it

One map of how things come to be, go on, change and end, whole enough to find one's own course on, joined and simple, its core proved in Lean, each piece holding under its stated conditions, and drawn from inside what it maps. The direction page (`_process/DIRECTION.md`) tells the aim, how far we are from it, and what has been found.

<a id="chinese-sources-and-becoming"></a>
### Mapping the relational thread in Chinese thought onto the spine

248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought (the 易传, the 老子 with its commentaries and excavated witnesses, the 儒家, the script with 止戈为武, 庄子 and 玄学, 墨辩 and 名家, 兵家 and 法家, Buddhist lines) are quoted verbatim from hash-bound texts and tied to checked laws of the spine: 91 agree, 98 hold within an exact scope, 59 diverge. Agreement means the spine has a law of the same structure, often only under premises the reading states, not that a passage is true as it says or that its authors meant the law. The relational start holds in every line and is a leading thread, not a property of every system; their universal forms mostly need a scope; four non-relational overlays (a prior ground, a fixed nature, a single centre, contest and rank) recur, each answered inside its own tradition. The script is relational as a system of readings, not in the shapes of its graphs. Most gaps the map found are proved in the core: the arrangements of the 傳 (`Becoming.HexagramSequences`), a code formed between formations (约定俗成, `Becoming.SharedCodes`), capture through the rule (二柄, 据有余而制不足; `Becoming.RuleCapture`) and two-sided regulation of a level and regulation that reads the level late (中和, 宽猛相济; `Becoming.Regulation`) have landed, and the four earlier Chinese chapters (in history since 23 October 2026) keep only what the map and the spine do not carry. The map was then extended to every one of the 5,673 complete judgments of 《中华思想脉络》 v1.0 (庄, 墨, 名辩, 兵 and 法 with 儒, 道, 佛 and the 易): 3,514 bear on a structure of the theory and each lies in one place in the cluster it was flagged for, in 1,300 checked entries; agreements and exact scopes are 81% of the judgments mapped, divergences 19%, 13% in pre-Qin texts. From those texts and the drafting 449 classical names were fixed, one per concept, 242 of the 248 quoted names witnessed before 秦, and the theory as it stood on 22 October 2026 (the book dated 21 October) was stated in them in the 中华本《变化论》, with 經, 說 and 證 for each law (in history since 23 October 2026, its laws now stated by the eight chapters, its 經 and each 篇's closing correspondences with the classical texts only in it). 文理生生, a classical-Chinese concept grammar built apart from the 中华本, was then compared with it: 88 of the 117 characters both judge agree (independence partial: the same corpus, both AI-written). 文 was named the course, a run's states read through a map step by step (`Becoming.Parting.course`), and the epistemology of 文 was tied link by link to checked laws, each with its scope (a correspondence, not a confirmation; whether classical Chinese is the best expression is untested).

**Next:** Review by people, the line's last step: the classifications, mappings, readings, names and the choices made in the censuses are all AI's, and no person's review of them is recorded. Two gaps stay open: the Hall-type existence condition for division across several conditions (分), of which a sufficient condition is proved, and a law grading by the least closure level from a centre, with whether that order is the same from every standpoint (亲亲之杀; the full reading of 《中华思想脉络》 marks it a note of scope, and there is no law yet). Tolerance compared across laws (柔弱者生之徒) is proved on both sides proposed (showing only that more tolerance gives no less, not that it is better), and every gap the full reading named is answered by a law or marked a note of scope. Also open, among others in chapter 6's Open: whether the readings agree with what the texts meant in their time; the 181 later candidates, untested; what change 穷 → 变 → 通 speaks of; and whether the corpus gives pairing and power.

<a id="universal-intelligence-session"></a>
### Developing significance, comparison and practical judgment

We are developing chapter 7's significance and comparison into the ethics for life, 生生, AI within it, offered as a way of seeing what a course draws on, what it opens and closes, and who bears it. The ethics emerges from continuation, with no should beyond becoming; a result that ranks courses names the hypotheses its theorem takes: the continuation condition (whose losses count), self-concern or `Comparison` (C), and any further premise it uses; living significance and explicit practical commitments support comparison, basic protection, bounded responsibility, transfer and appropriate ending. Current extensions address conflicting claims, uncertain classification and revisable judgment.

**Next:** Compare courses where serious losses and fair chances conflict, under the premises each result names; find the living relationships that change a concrete choice, including when a changed situation changes what an undertaking asks.

<a id="theory-of-evolution"></a>
### Investigating The Theory of Evolution

The laws of selection now stand on the Becoming spine with the flow: Price's equation and its selection term proper, Fisher's theorem in its exact-transmission case with offspring numbers bounded by what is given and taken, selection within and among groups with groups ending on conditions of their own, and what a rise draws from beyond. Organizing variation is explained through differentiation and feedback in social activity. The full explanatory and comparative claim remains active; the first falsifiable test found widening the coupling necessary, not sufficient.

**Next:** Groups on coupled conditions, the additive part of Fisher's theorem, drift, fixation with selection in the draw and mutation one way have landed (chapter 4, sections 4 to 6). Next, from chapter 4's open list: Wright–Fisher with selection; mutation both ways, and mutation with drift; assortment changing over cohorts; offspring numbers tied to what a formation gives, so that the share laws' premise follows from the flow; and inexact transmission across groups.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#theory-of-evolution) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-the-theory-of-evolution-goal.md)

<a id="generative-alignment"></a>
### Advancing AI alignment

The goal is an alignment that keeps the joint selection, humans and AI selecting together, out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: control of the selection's rule not captured, and a lock left in time by reading what lies beyond the share. The framework makes the purposes of intelligence, and the rules by which those purposes are formed and revised, objects of evaluation within one unfolding. Without any ethical premise, the spine proves what a selection reaches: exactly what couples into the selector, and no further however hard it optimizes through the same couplings; what tells two acts apart is selected only through a pool coupled into it (无明 and 明, pooled coupling). The direction is offered under the continuation condition, which fixes whose losses count, with the practical premises disclosed; its formal part is a schema in the pure core that compares moves by what their outcomes admit and does not use the condition: under J1/J2 a move whose outcome another's widens is not chosen, wherever it is decided whether the widening adds a basic admission; beside it, under J1/J2, where one move's outcome admits every basic admission any move's outcome admits, a basic admission it makes is not refuted at any chosen option, a double negation. The claim about actual AI systems stays a reviewed argument, and coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what an act responds to and fixes nothing within the bound, so nothing here proves compliance or reliability in deployment. In a commons, where the others alone outrun the renewal an end reward of any weight leaves a member's restraint unselected (a law); in a first frozen test three tabular learners each rewarded also on the end level still emptied the shared patch, against its prediction; in a second, learners kept a patch where the rest alone could not empty it and emptied it where it could, except where the level after every step was weighted above the exact threshold, weighting the end reading sixteenfold changed nothing, and two predicted keeps failed; while in a third, learners that generalize across states, run on the second's conditions, kept the stock in three of its six locked settings, the sixteenfold weight among them, so that weight changing nothing is a finding about tabular learners; whether a profile with restraint is an equilibrium there was not computed. In published training pipelines the signal is a function of what the deciders read, and three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering something the deciders do not read. A pool that recruits through its own coupling comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would, what a center can come to know of its reach grows by at most one coupling link a step, and a center, a loop of mutual reach, can represent all it acts on exactly where its acts return. Checked local results also connect rule revision to actual generation while allowing the realized form to change.

**Next:** Steps 1 to 7 of AJ's plan and AJ5 have landed, and on 23–25 November 2026 the Lean-first alignment track unified cadence-margin deadlines (`PacedStock`), multi-agent races and assume-guarantee composition (`AdaptiveLoops`, `OpenComposition`, `PolyComposition`, `OpenEndedComposition`), oplax relational-span and Beck–Chevalley obstructions (`RelSpan`, `OplaxHistory`, `DoubleKernel`), endogenous detection before capture lock and split evidence (`EndogenousEmergence`, `EndogenousDetectionRace`), composed spines with `not_entails` and sharpness countermodels (`AlignmentSpine`, `MasterSpine`), and the isolated `18`-module periphery (`FiniteProbKrylov`, `ObservationalFidelity`, `SurvivalDistinguishability`, `QuantitativeTransfer` Parts 1–9, `InterfaceBits`, `MovingFeatureCone`, plus `2` non-Mathlib modules), paired with the stylised `6`-test `guarded-alignment-runtime` (`28` tests), failure-first `neural-alignment-stress-lab` `B1`–`B5` + `b5_controls.py` (`19` tests; preserving `B4` `25–50%` collapses and `B5` `4/11` failed predictions `P8`–`P11`), Wave 2 `real-learner-b1-b2-b3` (`chosen_m = null`, `online_passed = false`), and `evidence-replay` (`16/16` tests); see `_process/DIRECTION.md`, `theories/becoming/ALIGNMENT-FOUNDATION.md`, and `theories/becoming/HUMAN-AUDIT-GUIDE.md`. Still open: independent human cold read and review; testing model-to-world recognition (Rule 2) beyond synthetic learners and stylised specs — including held `LA4` Stage B on language models, T7's held, unfrozen reader-premise test (`reform-events`), an institution whose readers are not drawn from the selected, and unbounded-domain endogenous scope/order formation.
